claim: Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2026 runs 7-31 August in Edinburgh, with more than 3,600 shows revealed.
quote: The festival runs from 07 - 31 August 2026. More than 3,600 shows have now been revealed

claim: Edinburgh Fringe 2025 issued over 2.6 million tickets across 3,893 shows in 301 venues, with 53,942 performances - establishing the scale precedent for 2026.
quote: more than 2.6 million tickets were issued across 3,893 shows... 301 venues host 53,942 performances from artists representing 62 countries

claim: Venice Carnival 2026 runs 31 January to 17 February in Venice, themed 'Olympus - The Origins of the Game' for the Milano-Cortina Olympic year, concluding on Shrove Tuesday 17 February.
quote: The Venice Carnival 2026 is scheduled from 31 January to 17 February... The conclusion of the Venice Carnival occurs on Tuesday, February 17, 2026, a day known as Shrove Tuesday

claim: Oktoberfest 2026, the 191st edition, runs 19 September to 4 October on Munich's 42-hectare Theresienwiese, spanning 16 days.
quote: In 2026, the 191st Oktoberfest will take place from September 19 to October 4 on the Theresienwiese. This spans a total of 16 days.

claim: Oktoberfest 2025 drew roughly 6.5 million guests over 16 days who drank about 6.5 million liters of beer, generating over EUR 1 billion for Munich.
quote: Approximately 6.5 million guests visited the festival over 16 days... Beer consumption was around 6.5 million liters... generates over EUR 1 billion for Munich's economy

claim: Pamplona's San Fermin 2026 festival runs 6 July (noon Chupinazo) to 14 July (midnight), with the Running of the Bulls held every morning 7-14 July at 8:00 am along an 875-metre route.
quote: The Running of the Bulls 2026 dates are July 7 - 14, 2026 in Pamplona, Spain... The San Fermin Festival dates are from July 6, 2026 at Noon, until July 14, 2026 at Midnight.

claim: San Fermin swells Pamplona from around 200,000 residents to roughly 1.5 million people, drawing over a million visitors.
quote: the city goes from 200,000 people up to 1.5 million during San Fermin... draws over a million tourists every year

claim: La Tomatina 2026 takes place 26 August in Bunol, Spain (last Wednesday of August), a one-hour tomato fight at noon in Plaza del Pueblo capped at 20,000 ticketed participants using over 100 metric tons of tomatoes.
quote: La Tomatina 2026 takes place on 26 August in Bunol, Spain... Over 100 metric tons of tomatoes are used with 20,000 participants... official ticketing limits participation to 20,000 people

claim: Rio Carnival 2026 main dates are 13-17 February in Rio de Janeiro, with Special Group Sambadrome parades on 15-16 February and the Champions' Parade on 21 February.
quote: The official dates for Rio Carnival 2026 are February 13-17, 2026... Feb 15-16 features Special Group parades (the main competition nights), and Feb 21 features the Champions' Parade

claim: Rio Carnival is a whole-city takeover via street blocos - 2025 had 482 blocos drawing roughly 8 million attendees and an estimated economic impact of R$5.7 billion.
quote: Carnival 2025 will generate R$5,7 billion in the city's economy... There were 482 blocos total... Rio de Janeiro expected eight million attendees for 2025 Carnival

claim: Las Fallas Valencia 2026 officially runs 1-19 March, with main events 15-19 March: La Planta (15-16), daily Mascleta fireworks, and the Crema burning of all monuments on 19 March.
quote: Las Fallas officially runs from 1 March to 19 March 2026, with the main events taking place between 15 and 19 March... 19 March - La Crema, when all the fallas sculptures are set on fire

claim: Las Fallas is a citywide takeover with nearly 800 falla monuments installed across Valencia and over three million visitors drawn to the streets in 2025.
quote: Las Fallas 2025 drew over three million visitors to Valencia's streets... almost 800 fallas were installed throughout the city

claim: Mardi Gras (Fat Tuesday) 2026 falls on 17 February in New Orleans, with Carnival season running from 6 January (Twelfth Night) and the biggest krewe parades in the final week, 11-17 February.
quote: Mardi Gras 2026 falls on Tuesday, February 17, with Carnival season running from January 6 through Fat Tuesday... The biggest, most well-known krewes are scheduled for the final weekend before Fat Tuesday, February 11-17, 2026
